notes: Sourced from Teradek's official VidiU Go Reference Guide (v1.0/v1.2, cdn.teradek.com), which includes a full "Technical Specifications" table and a labeled physical I/O diagram — more authoritative than the live teradek.com/products/vidiu-go marketing page, which lacks a full spec table. Product is discontinued (superseded by Teradek's Prism line) but specs are historically accurate. Two RP-SMA WiFi antenna connectors and a micro SD card slot exist on the device but are omitted since they are not physical AV/power signal ports in the given connector taxonomy (RF antenna and storage slot). No separate DC barrel/battery jack exists — the single USB-C port on the rear panel serves as the sole external power input (5V/up to 3A USB or USB Power Delivery), charging the internal 3.7V/5000mAh Li-polymer battery; nominal consumption 6.5W (up to 10W while charging). HDMI version is not explicitly stated by Teradek (only "HDMI Type A receptacle, non-HDCP") — hdmi-1.4 grade is inferred from supported resolutions/bitrates (max 1080p60, 12 Mbps), not confirmed, treat with medium confidence on that specific value. SDI grade (3G-SDI) and Ethernet grade (10/100 BASE-T, i.e. eth-100m, not gigabit) are both explicitly confirmed in the spec table.

ports.name: HDMI
ports.note: HDMI Type A receptacle, non-HDCP sources only. Supports up to 1080p60; spec sheet does not state HDMI version number, hdmi-1.4 inferred from supported resolutions/bitrates.

ports.name: 3G-SDI
ports.note: 75-ohm BNC, explicitly rated 3G-SDI per official spec sheet.

ports.name: Ethernet
ports.note: RJ45, 10/100 BASE-T per official spec sheet.

ports.name: USB modem port (left)
ports.note: Powered USB 2.0 host port for VidiU Node or compatible 3G/4G/LTE USB modem.

ports.name: USB modem port (right)
ports.note: Second powered USB 2.0 host port for VidiU Node or compatible 3G/4G/LTE USB modem.

ports.name: Type-C
ports.note: Powered USB-C host port used as the device's DC power input (5V USB charging or USB-PD); also charges internal 3.7V/5000mAh Li-polymer battery.

ports.name: Mic/Line
ports.note: 3.5mm TRS analog line-in or mic-in, unbalanced.

ports.name: Headphone
ports.note: 3.5mm TRRS headphone output with mic-in and adjustable volume; closest listed connector id is trs-3.5.
